entities.name: MAP3K14 (NIK)
observations: The 768-aa query sequence matches reviewed human MAP3K14 (UniProt Q99558) at 83.7% identity with 100% query coverage.
Sequence-derived estimates: 83.9 kDa, pI 8.81, GRAVY −0.549; theoretical values for unmodified sequence.
Pfam protein kinase domains detected at residues 404–598 (Pkinase PF00069) and 404–646 (PK_Tyr_Ser-Thr PF07714).
Reviewed human reference annotation describes MAP3K14 as a kinase in non-canonical NF-κB signaling; it phosphorylates CHUK/IKKα and promotes NFKB2/p100 processing.
